channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jason Collins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jason Collins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Jason Collins, Derrick Gordon
item.description:
“But I’m proud of Derrick and I’m proud of Jason Collins. It’s a big step for everybody and every generation.”

Kyrie Irving on Jason Collins, Derrick Gordon, Apr 10, 2014. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Jason Collins
item.description:
“But Jason Collins has been a pro for a long time. He's played with most of the guys that have been in the league for a long time. Him coming out when he came out ... I don't think was a surprise to a lot of people.”

Brian Shaw on Jason Collins, Feb 24, 2014. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Jason Collins
item.description:
“Even with [Missouri football player] Michael Sam, it was just only a matter of time. Every sport has had one, every sport most likely has one currently playing. ... But it takes a lot of courage to come out [like Collins did].”

Richard Jefferson on Jason Collins, Feb 24, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Billy King on Jason Collins
item.description:
Adrian Wojnarowski:Nets GM Billy King on Jason Collins signing:

“The decision to sign Jason was a basketball decision. We needed to increase our depth inside…”

Billy King on Jason Collins, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @WojYahooNBA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jason Collins
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on Jason Collins:

“We’ve been talking the last 3 or 4 days. Jason and I have texted and talked on the phone. I’m very happy for him.”

Doc Rivers on Jason Collins, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Jason Collins
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Dwyane Wade on Jason Collins:

“One thing I know about him is he fouled very hard.... Welcome back.”

Dwyane Wade on Jason Collins, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Jason Collins
item.description:
Eric Koreen:Jacque Vaughn on Collins:

“This is a league that is inclusive and respectful. ... Jason was one of the best teammates I ever had.”

Jacque Vaughn on Jason Collins, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @ekoreen.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Jason Collins
item.description:
Bill Oram:D'Antoni on Jason Collins:

“I hope one day if a player can play, he can play. If he can’t, he can’t. That’s all we should be talking about.”

Mike D'Antoni on Jason Collins, Feb 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @bill_oram.

item.title: Jarron Collins on Jason Collins
item.description:
“It’s not an issue. It was always the Collins twins, ‘are you Jason or Jarron?’ But now it’s Jason Collins, the first pro sport athlete who is [publicly] gay, and Jarron Collins. We’re separate in that sense.”

Jarron Collins on Jason Collins, May 5, 2013. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Jason Collins
item.description:
“Jason Collins, playing against him, seems like a great guy. Never got the chance to know him, but if he's happy, that's cool. Nobody has any right to judge. He's his own man, makes his own decisions. “As NBA players, it's like a big group of guys, kind of like a brotherhood. I know I support him. Like I said, I don't really know him, so whatever decision he makes is something he really thought was good for him. Nothing nobody else can about him. As long as he's happy, it's cool.”

Kevin Durant on Jason Collins, Apr 30, 2013. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: LeBron James on Jason Collins
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:LeBron on Jason Collins:

“I think it's a strong thing to do. I think it's very cool.”

LeBron James on Jason Collins, Apr 30, 2013. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Al Horford on Jason Collins
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:Al Horford on Jason Collins:

“I support him in his decision and wish him all the best in the future.”

Al Horford on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @ajchawks.

item.title: Billy King on Jason Collins
item.description:
Billy King:

“Jason Collins was a vital member of the New Jersey Nets for six and a half years, and as an executive with a competing NBA team, I always respected the standard he set for team play and the example he set for the league in playing with integrity and purpose. He exemplifies everything we look for in players, and for those players and associates within our organization, our primary focus is creating the most accepting and respectful environment for everyone to succeed.”

Billy King on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Jason Collins
item.description:
Chris Mannix:Brook Lopez, on Collins:

“I admire his dignity as well as his courage to come out. I'll always have his back.”

Brook Lopez on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @ChrisMannixSI.

item.title: David Stern on Jason Collins, Adam Silver
item.description:
NBA Commissioner David Stern statement on Jason Collins:

“As Adam Silver and I said to Jason, we have known the Collins family since Jason and Jarron joined the NBA in 2001 and they have been exemplary members of the NBA family. Jason has been a widely respected player and teammate throughout his career and we are proud he has assumed the leadership mantle on this very important issue.”

David Stern on Jason Collins, Adam Silver, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Emeka Okafor on Jason Collins
item.description:
Michael Lee:Okafor on how others will react toward Collins:

“Times are changing. I think that people are more accepting. How accepting, time will tell.”

Emeka Okafor on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Jason Collins
item.description:
Michael Lee:Garrett Temple on Jason Collins coming out as gay:

“I had no idea. Me & Jason, we’re...right next to each other in the locker room.”

Garrett Temple on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Grant Hill on Jason Collins
item.description:
Grant Hill:

“I’m not surprised that someone has come out. I’m very happy for Jason. I think it’s probably got to be liberating. He’s got to be able to feel free to get that out and not have to hide it for as long as he has. I think it will be interesting to see the response, if [Collins] wants to continue to play. I hope he does play, if he still wants to. It took a lot of courage and it’s very brave and I’m happy for him.”

Grant Hill on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Jason Collins
item.description:
Mark Berman:Kevin Durant on Jason Collins:

“If the guy's happy with whatever he does that's cool with me. Nobody has the right to judge. I support him.”

Kevin Durant on Jason Collins, Apr 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Jason Collins
item.description:
“I like it when guys stand up and fight like men. I think that's what the game's all about. The one thing that frustrates me is all the flopping. Jameer [Nelson] knocked over Jason Collins in the corner last night barely hitting him.”

Stan Van Gundy on Jason Collins, Apr 24, 2011. Source: Orlando Sentinel.
